title: Set up Mail App
intro: We check each part of your setup and tell you, in plain English, if anything needs fixing.
loadError: We couldn't run the checks. Check your internet connection, then press Check again.

app.title: Your Mail App
app.intro: These parts live on your Cloudflare account.

domain.title: Mail for {domain}
domain.intro: Other mail services check these settings before they trust your messages. If any say Fix this, your mail may arrive late or land in spam.

signin.label: Sign-in protection
signin.ok: Only you can open your inbox.
signin.fix: Sign-in protection isn't switched on, so anyone who finds this address could read your mail. Switch on Cloudflare Access for Mail App, then press Check again.
signin.unknown: Skipped while running on this computer for testing.

storage.label: Storage
storage.ok: Mail App can save your mail and attachments.
storage.fix: Mail App can't reach its storage. Check the R2 bucket in wrangler.jsonc, then deploy again.

sending.label: Sending
sending.ok: Mail App is connected to Cloudflare's email sending.
sending.fix: Mail App isn't connected to email sending. Check the send_email binding in wrangler.jsonc, then deploy again.

mx.label: Receiving
mx.ok: Mail for this domain comes to Mail App.
mx.fix: Mail for this domain goes somewhere else. In the Cloudflare dashboard, open this domain, go to Email, then Email Routing, and press Enable.
mx.unknown: We couldn't look this up. Press Check again in a minute.

spf.label: Permission to send
spf.ok: Your domain says Cloudflare may send mail for it.
spf.fix: Your domain doesn't yet say Cloudflare may send mail for it. Add or change this record:
spf.unknown: We couldn't look this up. Press Check again in a minute.

dkim.label: Signature
dkim.ok: Your messages are signed, so others can tell they really came from you.
dkim.fix: Your messages aren't signed yet. In the Cloudflare dashboard, open this domain, go to Email, then Email Routing, and follow its prompt to add the missing records.
dkim.unknown: We couldn't look this up. Press Check again in a minute.

dmarc.label: Protection from fakes
dmarc.ok: Your domain tells others what to do with fake mail pretending to be you.
dmarc.fix: Your domain doesn't yet tell others what to do with fake mail pretending to be you. Gmail and Outlook trust senders more when this is set. Add this record:
dmarc.unknown: We couldn't look this up. Press Check again in a minute.

fix.how: In the Cloudflare dashboard, open {domain}, go to DNS, then Records, then Add record.
fix.name: Name

noDomains: No domain is set up yet. Set DOMAINS in wrangler.jsonc, then deploy again.
allGood: Everything is set up. You're ready to go.
